description: Required implementation and integration tests, not claims made by package validation.

scenarios.given: unbound key and no account
scenarios.then: only onboarding-scoped session; payments/UMA/account access denied

scenarios.given: wallet bound to party A
scenarios.when: party B tries wallet binding or restored login
scenarios.then: account_mismatch; no ownership change or party data disclosed

scenarios.given: account with zero active wallets
scenarios.when: fresh account login and DELETE account
scenarios.then: 202, tombstone, credential revocation; no wallet signature required

scenarios.given: closed wallet
scenarios.then: login rejected; restore allowed with matching proof; address stays disabled

scenarios.given: deleted account
scenarios.when: background login or explicit signed onboarding restart
scenarios.then: login cannot resurrect; explicit restart creates isolated enrollment with no old party rights

scenarios.given: successful refresh response lost
scenarios.when: same key/old refresh token retried; then old token with different key
scenarios.then: first recovers identical rotation; second revokes family as reuse

scenarios.given: same x-only key with opposite compressed prefix
scenarios.then: cannot create second wallet identity or different owner

scenarios.given: valid internal document and matching required fields
scenarios.then: technical approved and photo_data_match_only; identification_status remains unidentified; UMA NOT_VERIFIED

scenarios.given: front upload, back upload, correction, lost submit response
scenarios.then: no conflicting legitimate writes; immutable submission processed once beyond response-cache expiry

scenarios.given: correction_requested at revision 1
scenarios.when: new revision then marked-field edits and resubmit
scenarios.then: revision 2; unmarked changes fail; revision 1 immutable

scenarios.given: approved revision and subsequent mismatching revision
scenarios.then: active approval is not silently revoked; pending revision status separately visible

scenarios.given: oversized body, excessive decoded pixels, wrong side/hash, truncated upload
scenarios.then: bounded rejection; no accepted document or decrypted temporary leftovers beyond policy

scenarios.given: account deleted while OCR/Keycloak task running
scenarios.when: late result commits or external timeout resolves
scenarios.then: generation/tombstone prevent activation; compensating cleanup occurs

scenarios.given: any new wallet submission
scenarios.then: no photo/full PII/history copied to Airtable, SharePoint or HubSpot

scenarios.given: all golden fixtures
scenarios.when: Android, iOS and Python implementations decrypt
scenarios.then: byte-identical payloads, AAD, exporter and response verification

scenarios.given: same envelope concurrently on multiple API replicas
scenarios.then: at most one accepted execution; replay storage failure fails closed

scenarios.given: revoked/expired/rolled-back key or stale app config
scenarios.then: fail closed without plaintext downgrade; local wallet stays accessible

scenarios.given: forged principal headers or valid service token without required user token
scenarios.then: no authority escalation; original user independently validated

scenarios.given: public route-map and unrelated legacy/custodial routes
scenarios.then: only exact intended methods/paths reachable; legacy protected routes retain Access

scenarios.given: same LNURL context
scenarios.when: concurrent same and differing amount callbacks
scenarios.then: one amount and registration; same amount recovers invoice; different amount fails

scenarios.given: helper reply lost; first POST still in transit
scenarios.when: GET missing then fence then late POST
scenarios.then: GET unknown; atomic fence prevents later SDK execution; no duplicate invoice

scenarios.given: two helper replicas and delayed old worker
scenarios.then: only current generation can deliver; late results retained as orphan evidence

scenarios.given: same operation ID and different recipient/amount/network/hash
scenarios.then: operation_conflict without second SDK invocation

scenarios.given: invoice expired, registration cancelled or recipient changed
scenarios.then: eligibility rechecked; old payments preserved separately; no redirect to new payee

scenarios.given: approved non-custodial wallet and operational limit above EUR-equivalent 1000 and explicit shadow mode
scenarios.when: larger allowed payment with pre-check outage
scenarios.then: no EUR gate; unavailable shadow pre-check recorded; custodial gate unaffected

scenarios.given: reinstallation and two devices
scenarios.when: same observation then same-status corrected fee
scenarios.then: first deduplicated; correction retained with new deterministic ID

scenarios.given: sequence gap plus later accepted and permanently rejected entries
scenarios.then: cursor stays contiguous; no arbitrary gaps closable; signed/opaque rejection receipt required

scenarios.given: forged settled observation without provider evidence
scenarios.then: never promoted to independently confirmed settlement or verified payer

scenarios.given: official pinned Python and JS SDK peer
scenarios.then: protocol serialization, IVMS@101.2023, ECIES and signatures interoperate; separate actual fixture hashes recorded

scenarios.given: UMA payerData and ordinary LNURL
scenarios.then: UMA SDK effective description bytes captured; normal LNURL unchanged; no Python/JS JSON whitespace mismatch

scenarios.given: forged raw peer response, stale nonce, internal URL or DNS rebinding
scenarios.then: no complete state or invoice accepted; no unsafe network request

scenarios.given: photo-only sender and external peer requiring verified identity
scenarios.then: NOT_VERIFIED; no invented fields/full-KYC claim; protocol failure recorded honestly

scenarios.given: signed post-transaction callback repeated or claiming COMPLETED
scenarios.then: bounded peer observation; one effect; no unsupported Spark settlement claim

scenarios.given: operator intent plus intended recipient
scenarios.when: both consent, stale version or foreign recipient tries consent
scenarios.then: atomic correct binding only; old unpaid contexts invalidated

scenarios.given: retained encrypted documents, queues and backup restoration
scenarios.then: all covered data deleted/restricted per approved matrix; tombstones applied before access; no resurrection

scenarios.given: isolated test wallet offline and independent external Lightning wallet
scenarios.when: server creates invoice with receiverIdentityPubkey then external payment
scenarios.then: actual funds credited only to intended user wallet; no LNbits/server-wallet routing; evidence captured

scenarios.given: non-custodial shadow and allow, deny, pending or unavailable result
scenarios.then: persist decision/outage and follow-up; no TME blocking

scenarios.given: enforcing and missing, stale, negative, pending or unavailable approval
scenarios.when: initial request, GET, callback, refresh and idempotent retry
scenarios.then: no BOLT11/QR exposed; negative is non-retryable 403, pending/unavailable retryable 503

scenarios.given: enforcing with transient outage and unknown helper outcome
scenarios.then: one registration; resolve existing helper operation before any replacement; do not cache transient failure permanently

scenarios.given: helper in flight under epoch 1 shadow
scenarios.when: epoch 2 enforcing committed before response authorization
scenarios.then: old epoch cannot authorize delivery; preserve withheld/orphan result; no new helper attempt from mode change

scenarios.given: invoice previously authorized and transmitted
scenarios.when: policy changes while response travels or invoice later settles
scenarios.then: document release linearization boundary; no claim of network-level revocation; actual settlement preserved

scenarios.given: party with custodial and non-custodial wallets
scenarios.when: forged custody/mode, stale replica or unsupported config
scenarios.then: server wallet decides; unknown policy fails closed; no downgrade; custodial gates unchanged

scenarios.given: fee, commission, internal ledger posting and unclassified movement
scenarios.then: exclude first three; unknown classification auditable and not silently trusted; client cannot classify itself out

scenarios.given: duplicate observations, verified payment, correction, conflict and later proof
scenarios.then: count eligible verified economic payment once per justified party/direction using settlement time; retract conflicts with audit

scenarios.given: invoice paid externally but app claims to be its sender
scenarios.then: payment evidence alone never verifies claimed sender; no fabricated outgoing total

scenarios.given: direct Spark payment while API enforcing
scenarios.then: record and assess after the event; no assertion API prevented or rolled back settlement

scenarios.given: mode or rule switch without privileged approval/audit
scenarios.then: reject; valid updates increment epoch with actor/reason/time and replica-consistency evidence

scenarios.given: fresh decision expires or verified totals/party restrictions change
scenarios.then: reauthorize against current input revision and approved policy; old approval cannot silently pass
